messages:
Priya K.: Hi team — day 6 onboarding check-in.

What I did:
- Finished local dotfiles + ssh key setup
- Attempted to pull the onboarding image and ran through the onboarding scripts PR

Blockers:
- Can't pull our private onboarding image from registry.redwood.internal: `docker pull registry.redwood.internal/onboard:latest` returns 401 unauthorized
- Don't have access to the `onboard-deploy` repo secrets to run CI

Commands I ran:
```
$ docker pull registry.redwood.internal/onboard:latest
Error response from daemon: unauthorized: authentication required
```

I opened a ticket but waiting on infra. Also created PR: https://git.redwood/internal/onboarding-scripts/pull/342 (adds `make dev-cert`). Any quick workarounds appreciated.

Jamie L.: Saw the PR, left small nits. For the registry try `echo $REGISTRY_TOKEN | docker login --username priya --password-stdin registry.redwood.internal` or `aws ecr get-login-password` if using ECR. @Taylor (infra) can you check tokens?

Taylor (infra): Creating ticket INF-789 and will rotate a short-lived token for you. In the meantime try the cred helper workaround:
```
$ printf "%s" "$TEMP_TOKEN" | docker login --username priya --password-stdin registry.redwood.internal
```
I'll DM the temp token in ~8m. Also adding Priya to group `registry-readers`.

onboarding-bot: INF-789 created and assigned to Taylor (infra) — https://infra.redwood/tickets/INF-789 :white_check_mark:

Alex M.: If you want to iterate without hitting the registry, you can `make dev-image` and use `./scripts/run-local.sh`. I also added the `onboarding` reviewer label to your PR so it routes to the right folks.

Jamie L.: Awesome — ping when you have the token, then we can run through a full CI run. :thumbsup:

Priya K.: Thanks everyone — will try the workaround now and report back.
